newsitem.title: HONG KONG: AT&T to deploy videoconf net for Halla group.
newsitem.headline: AT&T to deploy videoconf net for Halla group.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Wednesday it had reached a US$3.1 million consulting and systems integration services agreement with Korea's Halla group.

AT&T will work with Halla's information service division to design and deploy an enterprise-wide network to allow multimedia collaboration and video conferencing capability between Halla headquarters in Seoul and its 15 strategic business units.
The system will use an ATM network with the T1 transmission circuit interconnecting switch nodes with each other and the end points in Korea and other countries.
